name: arrow-up-down-circle
description: Two complete arrows pointing upward on the left and downward on the right inside a circle.
useCase: Switch between two choices or show a two-way transfer with a clear label.
misuse: The depicted directions are fixed. Label the transfer or switching action explicitly.

16.reason: Wider complete heads and slightly closer arrows keep both directions clear at text size.

24.reason: The full paired arrows retain their exact direction and spacing within the shared interface frame.
